description:
Mission is the Schema for the missions API.
A Mission represents an ephemeral round table — a temporary group of knights
assembled for a specific objective, with time-bounded execution and automatic cleanup.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: spec defines the desired state of Mission

briefing.description:
briefing is the initial context/instructions published to all mission knights
when the mission starts.

chains.description: chains lists chains to execute as part of this mission.

items.description: MissionChainRef references a chain to execute within the mission.

inputOverride.description: inputOverride provides mission-specific input data that overrides the chain's default input.

name.description: name is the Chain CR name to execute.

phase.description: phase controls when in the mission lifecycle this chain runs.

cleanupPolicy.description: cleanupPolicy controls what happens to ephemeral resources after mission completion.

costBudgetUSD.description:
costBudgetUSD is the maximum cost for this mission. When exceeded, the mission
is failed and cleanup begins. "0" means inherit from parent RoundTable.

generatedChains.description:
generatedChains stores chains created by the planner during Planning phase.
These chains are created as Chain CRs with owner references to the mission.

items.description: GeneratedChain represents a chain definition created by the planner.

description.description: description explains what this chain accomplishes.

input.description: input is the initial data for the chain.

name.description: name is the chain name (must be unique within the mission).

phase.description: phase controls when this chain runs (Setup, Active, Teardown).

backoffSeconds.description: backoffSeconds is the delay between retries in seconds.

maxRetries.description: maxRetries is the maximum number of retries per step.

items.description: ChainStep defines a single step in the pipeline.

continueOnFailure.description: continueOnFailure allows downstream steps to proceed even if this step fails.

dependsOn.description:
dependsOn lists step names that must complete successfully before this step runs.
If empty, the step runs immediately (or after the previous step in sequence).

knightRef.description: knightRef is the name of the Knight to execute this step.

name.description: name is a unique identifier for this step within the chain.

outputKey.description:
outputKey is the key name under which this step's output is stored for downstream steps.
Defaults to the step name if not specified.

outputPath.description:
outputPath is an optional file path where this step's output should be written.
Supports Go template variables: {{ .Date }} (YYYY-MM-DD), {{ .Chain }} (chain name), {{ .Step }} (step name).
When set, the controller dispatches a write task to the outputKnight after the step succeeds.

retry.description: retry configures per-step retry behavior, overriding the chain-level retryPolicy.

backoffSeconds.description: backoffSeconds is the delay between retries in seconds.

maxAttempts.description: maxAttempts is the maximum number of retry attempts for this step.

task.description:
task is the task prompt or instruction to send to the knight.
Supports Go template syntax with access to prior step outputs: {{ .Steps.step_name.Output }}

timeout.description: timeout is the per-step timeout in seconds. Overrides the knight's default taskTimeout.
timeout overrides the default chain timeout.

generatedKnights.description:
generatedKnights stores ephemeral knight specs created by the planner.
These knights are added to the knights list during Planning phase.

items.description: MissionKnight references a knight participating in a mission.

ephemeral.description:
ephemeral, if true, creates a temporary Knight for this mission that is cleaned up on completion.
When true, ephemeralSpec must be provided.

ephemeralSpec.description: ephemeralSpec defines the spec for an ephemeral knight. Only used when ephemeral=true.

arsenal.description: arsenal configures the skill arsenal git-sync sidecar.

image.description: image overrides the git-sync container image.

period.description: period is how often to sync (e.g., "300s").

ref.description: ref is the git ref to sync.

repo.description: repo is the git repository URL containing skills.

capabilities.description: capabilities configures optional runtime capabilities for the knight pod.

browser.description:
browser enables a headless Chrome sidecar with agent-browser CLI for web automation.
When true, the operator injects a browser sidecar and sets BROWSER_ENABLED=true.

concurrency.description: concurrency is the maximum number of concurrent tasks the knight can process.

domain.description:
domain is the knight's area of expertise (e.g., "security", "infrastructure", "finance").
Used for NATS subject routing and skill filtering.

env.description: env defines additional environment variables for the knight container.

items.description: EnvVar represents an environment variable present in a Container.

name.description:
Name of the environment variable.
May consist of any printable ASCII characters except '='.

value.description:
Variable references $(VAR_NAME) are expanded
using the previously defined environment variables in the container and
any service environment variables. If a variable cannot be resolved,
the reference in the input string will be unchanged. Double $$ are reduced
to a single $, which allows for escaping the $(VAR_NAME) syntax: i.e.
"$$(VAR_NAME)" will produce the string literal "$(VAR_NAME)".
Escaped references will never be expanded, regardless of whether the variable
exists or not.
Defaults to "".

valueFrom.description: Source for the environment variable's value. Cannot be used if value is not empty.

configMapKeyRef.description: Selects a key of a ConfigMap.

name.description:
Name of the referent.
This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is
allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are
almost certainly wrong.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

optional.description: Specify whether the ConfigMap or its key must be defined

fieldRef.description:
Selects a field of the pod: supports metadata.name, metadata.namespace, `metadata.labels['<KEY>']`, `metadata.annotations['<KEY>']`,
spec.nodeName, spec.serviceAccountName, status.hostIP, status.podIP, status.podIPs.

apiVersion.description: Version of the schema the FieldPath is written in terms of, defaults to "v1".

fieldPath.description: Path of the field to select in the specified API version.

fileKeyRef.description:
FileKeyRef selects a key of the env file.
Requires the EnvFiles feature gate to be enabled.

key.description:
The key within the env file. An invalid key will prevent the pod from starting.
The keys defined within a source may consist of any printable ASCII characters except '='.
During Alpha stage of the EnvFiles feature gate, the key size is limited to 128 characters.

optional.description:
Specify whether the file or its key must be defined. If the file or key
does not exist, then the env var is not published.
If optional is set to true and the specified key does not exist,
the environment variable will not be set in the Pod's containers.

If optional is set to false and the specified key does not exist,
an error will be returned during Pod creation.

path.description:
The path within the volume from which to select the file.
Must be relative and may not contain the '..' path or start with '..'.

volumeName.description: The name of the volume mount containing the env file.

resourceFieldRef.description:

generatedSkills.description:
generatedSkills contains inline skill definitions created by the planner.
Each skill is a markdown document mounted at /skills/<name>.md

items.description:
GeneratedSkill is an inline skill definition created by the planner.
Each skill is a markdown document that gets mounted into the knight's /skills/ directory.

content.description: content is the full markdown skill document.

name.description: name is the skill filename (without .md extension).

image.description:
image is the container image for the knight runtime.
If empty, the operator uses DEFAULT_KNIGHT_IMAGE env var.

idleTimeout.description:
idleTimeout is how long after the last task before auto-suspending.
Only used when SuspendPolicy is "auto" (e.g., "30m", "1h").

suspendPolicy.description:
suspendPolicy controls when the knight is suspended.
Values: auto, manual, never (default: never)

model.description: model is the AI model to use (e.g., "openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v3.2", "claude-sonnet-4-20250514").

nats.description: nats configures the knight's NATS JetStream consumer and subjects.

consumerName.description:
consumerName overrides the auto-generated durable consumer name.
Defaults to "knight-{name}".

maxDeliver.description: maxDeliver is the maximum number of delivery attempts per message.

resultsStream.description: resultsStream is the JetStream stream to publish results to.

stream.description: stream is the JetStream stream name to consume from.

subjects.description:
subjects defines the JetStream filter subjects for task consumption.
e.g., ["fleet-a.tasks.security.>"]

url.description: url is the NATS server URL.

nixPackages.description:
nixPackages lists nix packages to install during knight bootstrap.
Packages are installed via: nix profile install nixpkgs#<pkg>

prompt.description: prompt allows overriding the knight's system prompt components.

configMapRef.description:
configMapRef references a ConfigMap containing prompt overrides.
Keys: "AGENTS.md", "TOOLS.md", "SOUL.md"

name.description:
Name of the referent.
This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is
allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are
almost certainly wrong.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

identity.description: identity overrides the knight's identity/persona description.

instructions.description: instructions provides additional instructions appended to the system prompt.

resources.description: resources defines compute resource requirements for the knight container.

cpu.description: cpu is the CPU limit for the knight container.

memory.description: memory is the memory limit for the knight container.

runtime.description:
runtime selects the backend for managing this knight's pod.
"deployment" uses a standard Kubernetes Deployment (default).
"sandbox" uses Agent Sandbox (agents.x-k8s.io) for lifecycle management.

serviceAccountName.description:
serviceAccountName is the name of the ServiceAccount to use for the knight pod.
If empty, the namespace default ServiceAccount is used.

skills.description:
skills defines which skill categories this knight has access to.
The operator will configure the skill-filter sidecar accordingly.

suspended.description: suspended, if true, scales the knight deployment to 0 replicas.

taskTimeout.description: taskTimeout is the default task timeout in seconds.

tools.description: tools defines additional system packages and tools the knight needs.

apt.description: apt is a list of apt packages to install (fallback, requires root — prefer nix).

mise.description: mise is a list of tools to install via mise (e.g., "shodan", "kubectl").

nix.description:
nix is a list of nixpkgs packages to install via Nix flakes (e.g., "nmap", "whois", "dnsutils").
These get compiled into a flake.nix and built on first boot, cached on the Nix PVC.

vault.description: vault configures the shared Obsidian vault mount.

claimName.description: claimName is the PVC name for the shared vault.

readOnly.description: readOnly mounts the base vault as read-only.

writablePaths.description: writablePaths are subpaths within the vault the knight can write to.

workspace.description: workspace configures the knight's persistent workspace.

existingClaim.description:
existingClaim references an existing PVC to use instead of creating a new one.
Useful for migrating existing knights to operator management.

size.description: size is the storage request for auto-created PVCs.

name.description: name is the knight's name. If it matches an existing Knight CR, that knight is used.

role.description: role describes this knight's role within the mission (e.g., "lead", "researcher", "reviewer").

specOverrides.description:
specOverrides allows patching specific fields when using templateRef.
Applied as a strategic merge patch on top of the template spec.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

costBreakdown.description: costBreakdown provides per-knight cost information for this mission.

items.description: MissionKnightCost tracks per-knight cost information for a mission.

costUSD.description: costUSD is the cost in USD for this knight during the mission.

ephemeral.description: ephemeral indicates whether this knight was created ephemerally for this mission.

name.description: name is the knight's name.

expiresAt.description: expiresAt is when the mission will be auto-cleaned based on TTL.

knightStatuses.description: knightStatuses tracks the status of each participating knight.

items.description: MissionKnightStatus tracks the status of a knight within the mission.

ephemeral.description: ephemeral indicates whether this knight was created ephemerally for this mission.

name.description: name is the knight name.

ready.description: ready indicates the knight is ready and connected to the mission NATS subjects.

tasksCompleted.description: tasksCompleted is the number of tasks this knight completed during the mission.

natsResultsStream.description: natsResultsStream is the JetStream stream name for mission results.

natsTasksStream.description: natsTasksStream is the JetStream stream name for mission tasks.

observedGeneration.description: observedGeneration is the most recent generation observed by the controller.

phase.description: phase is the current lifecycle phase of the mission.

planningResult.description: planningResult contains the output from the planner knight.

chainsGenerated.description: chainsGenerated is the number of chains the planner created.

knightsGenerated.description: knightsGenerated is the number of ephemeral knights the planner created.

rawOutput.description: rawOutput is the complete planner output (truncated if large).

skillsGenerated.description: skillsGenerated is the number of new skills the planner created.

planningTaskID.description:
planningTaskID is the NATS task ID dispatched to the planner knight.
Used to prevent duplicate dispatches during reconcile loops.

result.description: result is a summary of the mission outcome.

resultsConfigMap.description:
resultsConfigMap is the name of the ConfigMap containing preserved results
(only set when retainResults=true and mission is complete).

roundTableName.description: roundTableName is the name of the ephemeral RoundTable created for this mission.

startedAt.description: startedAt is when the mission began.

totalCost.description: totalCost is the cumulative cost in USD of all tasks during this mission.
